description: March 7 birthday meaning: Pisces decan 2, birthday number 7, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a March 7 birthday falls in Pisces, in the second decan, with Neptune as the sign's ruler and Moon as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 7. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Pisces is mutable and water.

sections.heading: Personality of a March 7 birthday
paragraphs: Seven, linked with contemplation and inner search, finds natural company in Pisces. March 7 places the Sun about sixteen degrees into Neptune's sign, with the Moon colouring the decan. The traditional reading is a dreamy, introspective temperament that needs quiet water, long walks or late nights to process what it feels.

By noon UTC on March 7, the Sun has normally reached roughly 16° of Pisces. That places the date in the Pisces decan that astrologers give to Moon, the second of three. The Moon, which rules Cancer, acts as sub-ruler for Pisces between 10 and 19 degrees, roughly the first ten days of March. This decan tends to turn the sign's compassion towards home, family and the people closest at hand. Early-March birthdays are often linked with nurturing, intuitive and emotionally receptive temperaments, with long memories and a deep need to feel safe. The lunar influence can make moods ebb and flow in quick cycles. When they look after their own emotional tides as carefully as they tend other people's, these Pisceans often become the steady harbour that others return to.

sections.heading: Numerology of the March 7 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 7th, you have a birthday number of 7 in its plain form. Numerology treats the birth day as a secondary influence, often visible in how a person thinks rather than what they do. The 7 has long been regarded as the seeker's number, linked with analysis, solitude and questions that do not have quick answers. Natives of the 7th are frequently described as observant, private and happiest when they can go deep into a subject. Time alone tends to recharge them, and trust in their intuition often grows as they learn when to stop overthinking.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same March 7 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 1 for 1980, 11 for 1990, 3 for 2000 and 4 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: March 7 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A March birthday falls around the spring equinox for the northern hemisphere, the season of thaw and first growth, while southern birthdays mark the turn into autumn. The month is split between Pisces and Aries, with the change around March 20 or 21. In numerology March is month 3, linked with expression, creativity and sociability, a lively number for a month that ends with the zodiac starting over. March 7 is the 66th day of the year (67th in a leap year). In most years Aries season is under way by March 21, 14 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a March 7 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. March 7 is also the birthday of Alessandro Manzoni (1785), Maurice Ravel (1875) and Tomáš Garrigue Masaryk (1850).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is March 7?
faq.answer: March 7 is Pisces in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Pisces, which tradition links with Moon.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on March 7?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On March 7 the Life Path is 8 in 1960, 9 in 1970, 1 in 1980, 11 in 1990, 3 in 2000, 4 in 2010 and 5 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 7 for everyone born on the 7th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on March 7?
faq.answer: By March 7 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on March 7?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a March 7 birthday are Alessandro Manzoni (1785), Maurice Ravel (1875) and Tomáš Garrigue Masaryk (1850). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
